summary: Round-2 frontend-form repair, all through shared paths. (1) Descending ranges: tir.Loop carries a descending flag pinned by the TIR verifier to the compile-time step sign; the counted head test continues while i stays ABOVE upper (scalar.py begin_counted_loop slt with swapped operands) and the break/return while-form conversion compares gt; 4 operators (reversed_cumsum, nonzero_kernel, cholesky_solve, fused_lu_solve) now build artifacts. (2) ==1 specialization: an int argument equal to 1 is a constexpr 1 exactly like pinned native_specialize_impl (specialize.env + _bind_params), so deconv3d's 'if groups == 1' folds and the dead else arm's block-tensor 'if lane_mask:' never lowers; a non-==1 identity keeps the located pinned refusal. (3) Block-pointer method advance: '.advance' maps to tl.advance (the pinned @_tensor_member_fn), list-literal and runtime-offset sequences accepted. (4) Boolean block logic: i1 add/sub is mod-2 = mask xor and i1 mul = mask and; cmp.eq/ne over masks is xnor/xor -- new vmxor.mm repertoire row (assembler-probed) in a100c/backend/repertoire.py. (5) Grid: a symbolic conditional stays an identity-preserving hole (fillable by view/scalar/meta ties), np.asarray/elementwise-np/reshape(-1) keep structurally tracked extents, and a quotient solve reads an untied leaf/hole/subtree exactly once in a view-extent product as view_extent // readable-cofactors; 38 of 47 grid rows now extract (self-checked, no baking), gn_finalize/chunk_abc keep located refusals. (6) Layout: the staged-block axis map tries positional alignment then the UNIQUE equal-extent matching (tiled_argmin fixed). (7) scalarize runs vextract inside its value's own region (cholesky_solve bf16 class); the staging analysis includes scalar segments (softsign (1,) bf16); rank-0 bool if-joins normalize to the i64 GPR convention; the {0,1}-class reduction widens to the declared width when no merge frame owns it (cholesky_upper fp16/bf16). Filtered sweep over all 24 class-carrying operators: 101 identities -> 61 artifacts + 40 located refusals, classes range/if/gQ.advance/arith.add/cmp.eq/add at ZERO, grid 15<47 (all naming the untraceable input), layout 1<4; 19 repeat cases reused one artifact (no baking). Full a100c test suite (37 files) PASS; new a100c/tests/test_t033_repairs.py executes every repaired class on the pinned QEMU endpoint at 1 and 4 workers against independent numpy references.
